pages.title: One identity across desktop and mobile
pages.body: Desktop and mobile views share naming and brand rules. The smaller screen rearranges information around the primary action.

images.caption: Biyuan desktop homepage
Biyuan mobile homepage

pages.title: Support browsing and deliberate search
pages.body: Model lists and name search support two different tasks. Hierarchy helps users identify a model, understand its entry point and continue.

images.caption: Biyuan model directory
Filtered model search

pages.title: Make automated rewriting reviewable
pages.body: Before-and-after differences let the user choose which changes to keep. Confirmation and undo preserve control over the text.

images.caption: Reviewing an AI rewrite diff in Resume Formatter

pages.title: Give the master and variants distinct roles
pages.body: The master retains stable facts; role-specific versions choose emphasis. Evidence links keep wording close to its supporting record.

images.caption: Master resume, job version and evidence workspace

pages.title: Make layout changes visible and reversible
pages.body: Templates change presentation rather than silently changing facts. This tool builds on an MIT upstream fork; this portfolio’s independent Word-export pipeline is not a feature claim about that editor.

images.caption: Resume Formatter template and layout controls

pages.title: Keep spatial input and feedback together
pages.body: Objects, parameters and views share one editor. Drawing, selection and constraints help users understand the next action.

images.caption: Formline desktop geometry editor

pages.title: Preserve the spatial task on a small screen
pages.body: Mobile reallocates attention between tools and canvas. X-Ray exposes internal relationships while retaining an explicit way back.

images.caption: Formline mobile X-Ray view

pages.title: Make the income model understandable
pages.body: A clear first-run configuration connects home-screen values to user inputs. Native WeChat developer-tool captures document this interface.

images.caption: Salary configuration in Xintiao onboarding
Xintiao native home screen

pages.title: Let users inspect the number
pages.body: The detail view explains a result; the calendar handles days without records. Empty states are part of the workflow.

images.caption: Xintiao salary details
Xintiao calendar with no completed records

pages.title: Let users control appearance and motion
pages.body: Themes and motion controls accommodate preferences. The native mini-program reuses PayDance’s AGPL-3.0-only calculation core, credited separately from interface work.

images.caption: Xintiao appearance and animation settings

pages.title: Establish input context before the task
pages.body: Guidance and sample material provide a starting point. Material, task and result share a workspace that supports stepwise progress and recovery.

images.caption: Lensflow onboarding and demo workspace

pages.title: Reuse structured material analysis
pages.body: Structured output helps analysis feed later tasks. This public demonstration uses precomputed results and does not claim live model inference.

images.caption: Lensflow image analysis and structured results

pages.title: A controllable creative workflow
pages.body: A film-language reference, a new story and two character inputs become a storyboard, Blender blocking, controlled imagery and prompts, then a Seedance 2.5 render. The 11 storyboard units and 20+ characters are my process-log counts.

images.caption: Workflow map from case observation to a reviewed output
A Blender blocking frame from the supplied source video used to check camera and cast relations

pages.title: Review relationships, then revise the right layer
pages.body: A searchable reference index, six control layers and eight analyses connect product, CMF, space and narrative. The personal 22.08-second film remains a process record; the page separates source analysis from personal workflow application. Explore Systems / AI video methods on the website.

images.caption: Six control layers for an AI video workflow
Review relationships, then revise the right layer

pages.title: Character, action and ink
pages.body: Small gestures trigger ink at landscape scale. The complete script organises eight action passages; the film records the relationship between camera, identity and effects. Open the case to watch.

images.caption: Ink Step: ground-level motion and dry-brush trails
Ink Lotus: layered black ink and muted gold

pages.title: Organise the visual definition around identity
pages.body: Views, expressions, micro-expressions, clothing and hands form a visual definition that can be inspected repeatedly. The full case retains five images and the input template.

images.caption: Character sheet: a shared reference for views and details

pages.title: Light type, direction and visible results
pages.body: Turn lighting into short, inspectable prompts. Nose shadows, wall shadows and hair highlights guide concrete revisions. The full archive retains nine images and every comparison.

images.caption: Soft and hard light: changes in nose and chin shadows
